policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Southern New Hampshire beat Franklin Pierce and American International beat Bentley on Wednesday, each by a single goal. The two meet at Southern New Hampshire on Saturday; the hosts won September's meeting there and sit three points above American International in the conference table.

claims.label: signal
claims.text: Southern New Hampshire's fifty-five goals come from at least sixteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is the work of a squad rather than a single forward.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Southern New Hampshire have lost one match all season; American International are next to visit.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Guillermo Rios has scored seventeen of Franklin Pierce's thirty-five goals.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Pace have conceded thirty-eight goals, more than any other programme.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Southern Connecticut have drawn seven matches, more than any other programme.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Saint Anselm have won eight matches and lost eight, and remain the only programme yet to draw a match.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Javier Solá Martínez has kept eight clean sheets in goal for American International.
